services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: A visit to the Springs Preserve is an immersive educational experience designed to inspire curiosity and deepen understanding. With attractions and exhibits aligned to the science and social studies Nevada Academic Content Standards (NVACS), we aim to spark lifelong learning that extends far beyond the classroom walls. Want to explore the Springs Preserve with your students? Take them on a free self-guided tour! Self-guided tours are generally offered Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays from 10:15 a.m. to 12:15 p.m. (Non-CCSD schools may take the self-guided tour Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays, from 12:15 to 2:15 p.m.) Our free self-guided school tours are available for the classes of teachers

services.name: Botanical Garden
services.desc: With thousands of Mojave Desert and desert-adapted plants, the Botanical Garden at the Springs Preserve provides an inviting oasis and inspiration for Las Vegas residents and visitors alike. The Preserve's collection received the Award for Garden Excellence from Horticulture Magazine and was named one of the "Top 10 North American Gardens Worth Traveling For" at the Garden Tourism Awards. Preservation is part of the Botanical Garden’s story, too! Nearly all of the native and cacti and yucca species on the grounds were rescued from local lands that were being developed for residential or commercial use.
